p: There is no God: He shows that the cause of all wickedness if forgetting God.
corrupt: There is nothing but disorder and wickedness among them.
all gone aside: David here makes comparisons between the faithful and the reprobate, but Paul speaks the same of all men naturally, Ro 3:10.
There were they in great fear: Where they think themselves most sure.
shamed the counsel of the poor: You mock them who put their trust in God.
Israel were come out of Zion: He prays for the whole Church whom he is assured God will deliver: for no one else but he can do it.
